name: Neko Raku Tei Sawa ~Negai no Kanau Koro~
original_name: 猫楽亭茶話 ～願いの叶う頃～
source:
There is a cat store where people come to get happiness. Four stories happening at different nights are presented.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一家为人们带来幸福的猫咪商店。故事发生在不同的夜晚，共有四篇。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url]]
